// Expected values for the farmer's work and the fields' growth (docs/rules/farming.md), captured from the original program in the emulator
// (ADR 0008): tools/GhidraDump/emulate.py, the verb goods with a finished farm (type 12, a large building) at a flag, reduced to the passes
// that matter. The farmer is the castle's jobless settler (slot 3) with a scythe from the stock of level 30. A scenario starts with a "#" line
// that names its verb command; each line after it gives, for a pass, the 16 bytes of the farmer (sf=, slot 3) where his state changed (and at a
// checkpoint every 250 passes), the 18 bytes of the farm (b=) where they changed, the farm's flag byte 4 and goods bytes (g=) where they
// changed, the castle's grain count (grain=) where it changed, the object bytes that changed (o=x,y:old>new;...), and the generator's words
// (rng=) as they stand. A field is an object 0x69 to 0x6f or 0x79 to 0x7e. The scenario field-stages sets one field of each code from 0x69 to
// 0x7e by hand before pass 2 (the verb's SET field), ripe-fields sets ripe and grown fields in the farmer's reach, and no-room sets a tree on
// every node of his reach where the original would sow, so that he finds none. Not production code: no routine of the program is
// transcribed here, only values the program produced.
